title: Union Square, San Francisco
_comment_bbox: Unchanged from the existing reconstruction: WGS84 37.7850-37.7910 N, -122.4115 to -122.4035 W, about 800 x 720 m.
_comment_frame: Origin is the Dewey Monument centroid (OSM way 616479962). ORIGIN_ELEVATION_M 23.94 reproduced live from USGS EPQS on 2026-09-03 (value 23.940353394, 1 m raster, acquired 2023-03-04). Grid bearing is the orthogonal fit to Powell/Stockton/Geary/Post.

sources._comment: Pinned release. Bump deliberately and re-run camera-match QA; an unpinned 'latest' would make every rebuild produce different geometry.
25 m grid over the bbox; San Francisco's block-scale grade needs it and the brief says the environment must not accidentally become flat.
Muni stops and the Powell St cable-car alignment. GTFS route_type 5 is the cable tram.
Camera-match ground truth. Stores the manifest; ingest re-downloads pixels into the gitignored refs/ tree on demand.
The licence-clean substitute for Street View. Needs a free MAPILLARY_TOKEN; skipped cleanly without one.
